vision.note: Vision V1 is an independent observation service. Values are supplied only through environment variables. QWEN_BASE_URL is the provider endpoint without /chat/completions and must end in the provider's OpenAI-compatible path segment (for an Alibaba Cloud Model Studio dedicated endpoint that is /compatible-mode/v1, not the /api/v1 shown in the console). SOIL3_VISION_ZONES_PATH lists one fixed rect per plant zone; each zone is observed and tracked separately.
